$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/floor-auth.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Office administrators keep devices, workers, badges, floor roles and floor settings as factory_runtime, inside their tenant (apps/factory-api platform/auth/floor, through command(); the API keeps them to the companies and sites their grants reach). Everything a tablet does runs as factory_floor_runtime in the device's site (tenant and site come from the device token): trading an enrolment code for the device token, signing a worker in and out, counting wrong PINs, sliding the idle end, reading the floor roles of the signed-in worker. So the floor role reads and writes only its own site's rows; it never inserts a device, a worker or a badge, and never sees a worker's office-user link. No role deletes: devices are revoked, workers deactivated, badges revoked, roles and sessions ended. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Device.about: Office: the device registry (enrol, rename, move to a station, revoke). Floor: the device reads its own row by its token, takes its token at enrolment (status, tokenHash), points at its current session and records its last contact.

DeviceEnrolment.about: Office makes and retires one-time codes; the tablet (floor, in the code's site) reads its code and marks it used.

Worker.about: Office keeps the floor workers (name, language, employee number, status, PIN reset). Floor reads its site's workers to sign one in (the roster for name + PIN), checks the PIN, counts wrong PINs and stores a PIN the worker changed; it never sees the link to an office user.

Badge.about: Office issues and revokes badges; floor looks a scanned badge up by its code hash.

WorkerRole.about: Office gives and ends floor roles; the floor authenticator reads the signed-in worker's live ones to build the session's grants.

FloorSession.about: Floor writes the sessions of its devices (sign-in, switch, sign-out, the idle slide, a PIN step-up, closing an expired one) and reads them on every request; office ends them when it revokes a device or badge, deactivates a worker or resets a PIN, and reads whether a device is in use.

FloorSettings.about: Office sets a site's idle minutes, shift ends and whether a badge alone signs a worker in; floor reads its site's row at sign-in.
